title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 47
description: Ten questions on Psalms 47: the nations clap their hands, God goes up with a shout and a trumpet, and he reigns as King of all the earth.

questions.text: In verse 1, what are all the nations told to do with their hands?
questions.explanation: Psalms 47:1 says, "Oh clap your hands, all you nations."

questions.text: How does verse 2 describe Yahweh Most High?
questions.explanation: Psalms 47:2 says, "Yahweh Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth."

questions.text: According to verse 3, God subdues peoples under what?
questions.explanation: Psalms 47:3 says, "He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet."

questions.text: What does God choose for his people, according to verse 4?
questions.explanation: Psalms 47:4 says, "He chooses our inheritance for us."

questions.text: Verse 4 calls the inheritance "the glory of" whom?
questions.explanation: Psalms 47:4 calls it "the glory of Jacob whom he loved."

questions.text: With the sound of what has Yahweh gone up?
questions.explanation: Psalms 47:5 says, "God has gone up with a shout, Yahweh with the sound of a trumpet."

questions.text: In verse 7, how are the people told to sing praises?
questions.explanation: Psalms 47:7 says, "For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding."

questions.text: According to verse 8, where does God sit?
questions.explanation: Psalms 47:8 says, "God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne."

questions.text: The princes of the peoples are gathered as the people of the God of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalms 47:9 says the princes of the peoples are gathered together, "the people of the God of Abraham."

questions.text: To whom do the shields of the earth belong, according to verse 9?
questions.explanation: Psalms 47:9 says, "For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!"
